text:
Review complete — I read every source file, the tests, the config/build scripts, and the committed output artifacts. Here's the honest assessment.

## Overall impression

The code itself is better than average contractor work: small focused modules, type hints, deterministic seeding, `yaml.safe_load`, no security red flags. But it has one disqualifying problem and a credibility problem.

**The disqualifying problem: the repo cannot run.** `run_extract` (emovec/extract.py:26-27) unconditionally loads `data/stories/manifest.json` and per-emotion story files via `load_stories` (emovec/data.py:24-36) — and there is no `data/` directory anywhere in the repo. The contractor ran the pipeline against a local story dataset that was never committed (you can see its manifest echoed inside `outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json`). The README claims stories are "loaded or generated," but no generation code exists. Consequence: `make demo`, `run_demo.sh`, and the end-to-end test `tests/test_integration_tiny.py` all fail with `FileNotFoundError` on a fresh checkout. The test suite does not pass as shipped, despite the README implying it does.

**The credibility problem: the tiny-mode "validation" is circular.** During extraction the tiny backend is handed the ground-truth emotion label (`label_hint`, emovec/extract.py:32), which injects 2.0× the true emotion direction straight into the synthetic activations (emovec/model.py:147-148). And the tiny `preference_logit` hard-codes the expected steering outcome as `valence × category_valence` (emovec/model.py:182-191). So when the integration test asserts `diagonal_gt_off_diagonal is True` and the steering tests assert the logit moves, they are asserting facts baked into the mock, not properties of the method. A deterministic demo backend is defensible; presenting its outputs as validation results is not. There is zero test coverage of the real HF backend.

## Concrete issues

| # | Location | Sev | Issue |
|---|----------|-----|-------|
| 1 | extract.py:26-27, data.py:24-36 | high | Required `data/stories/` dataset (manifest + txt files) absent from repo; demo, full run, and integration test all fail on fresh clone |
| 2 | README.md:11, 103-109 | high | Claims story "generation" and a passing end-to-end test suite; neither is true |
| 3 | extract.py:32, model.py:144-153 | medium | Ground-truth `label_hint` injected into tiny activations — context/scenario validation is true by construction |
| 4 | model.py:175-192 | medium | Tiny `preference_logit` hard-codes the steering result; steering tests verify the mock, not the method |
| 5 | model.py:306-308 | medium | Only first token of `" good"`/`" bad"` encodings used for the preference logit; silently wrong for multi-token tokenizations |
| 6 | model.py:236-241 | medium | If offset mapping is unavailable or matching fails, steering silently applies to every token in the prompt instead of activity tokens |
| 7 | validate_contexts.py:66 | medium | When `"afraid"` isn't in the emotion set, silently substitutes emotion index 0 but still writes files labeled `afraid_dosage` |
| 8 | model.py:262-268 | medium | Prompt asks for "a preference score" but the measurement is logit(" good") − logit(" bad") — prompt/metric mismatch |
| 9 | model.py:252-260 | low | Logit lens applies `lm_head` to raw residual without final RMSNorm (and ignores Gemma logit softcapping) — methodologically loose |
| 10 | steer_prefs.py:45-49 | low | If fewer than 2 positive or 2 negative correlations exist, selection silently falls back to `emotions[:4]` with no warning |
| 11 | extract.py:34-36 | low | Effective-start logic duplicated from `layer_position_mean`; manifest reporting can drift from actual computation |
| 12 | config.yaml:50 | low | `steering.min_reported_emotions` is read nowhere — dead config |
| 13 | config.py:42-54 | low | No config validation; missing `scale`/`tiny` sections silently default to 0 topics/stories and crash later with an opaque `KeyError` |
| 14 | validate_contexts.py:26-27 | low | Empty scenario/emotion overlap crashes `np.stack` with a confusing error instead of a clear message |
| 15 | model.py:79-81 | low | `final_activation` reruns a full forward pass per call — redundant compute in HF mode for scenario and activity loops |
| 16 | outputs/ (committed) | low | Generated artifacts (npy, png, csv) committed to the repo |

Notably absent: real security problems. No injection, no unsafe deserialization, no secrets. This is a research-tooling quality problem, not a security one.

## Rewrite estimate

The repo is ~1,100 lines of Python. Issues 5-16 are localized fixes (~80 lines touched). The big-ticket items are adding story generation or a committed dataset plus loader wiring (~100-120 new/changed lines in data.py/extract.py), and decoupling the tiny backend from ground-truth labels enough that the tests measure something (~50-60 lines in model.py/extract.py/tests). Call it **~220 lines** rewritten or significantly changed, plus a small committed dataset.

## Bottom line

**No, I would not approve this as-is.** Not because the code is sloppy — it's mostly clean — but because the deliverable doesn't run from a clean checkout, its test suite fails, and the tests that do exist validate a mock that's rigged to pass. Fix issue #1, make the tiny backend honest (or relabel its outputs as smoke tests), and this becomes an approvable 7/10 codebase fairly quickly.
